ava: Dropping a compact review thread final pass on the latency card tweaks. Focus: tiny-card heatmap, keyboard-first navigation, sampling UX, and mobile gestures. Need quick calls so eng can start. rui: Thanks. Which questions need decisions now? ava: Short list: 1) show minimap scrubber under heatmap or a compact vertical overview? 2) sampling presets + adaptive auto-tune behavior? 3) how the screen-reader voice summary should differ from the visual tooltip. 4) mobile two-finger pan vs finger scrub. jamal: For perf, minimap under the chart is easiest and familiar. Vertical overview feels cramped. Minimap should be low-res and not trigger extra queries. heo: (typo, but include) tho: agree minimap bottom. Add a tiny draggable scrubber handle that snaps to bucket centers. keyboard: left/right to move bucket, shift+arrows to jump by 5. lisa: Accessibility notes: mirror DOM grid as we did before, lazy-mount when keyboard input or SR detected. For SR voice summaries, propose two verbosity modes: concise (default) and verbose (pref). Concise: "Bucket 3 of 8: p95 210 ms, 68 reqs". Verbose: "Bucket 3 of 8 representing requests from 12:30 to 12:35; median 45 ms; 95th percentile 210 milliseconds; 68 requests." Let users pick in prefs. celeste: Product likes adaptive sampling idea: start with preset (5%), but if cardinality is high we auto-increase sample to keep visual SNR. Show a subtle badge: "auto 7%" and an option to lock to manual. jamal: Backend: we can expose sample_autotune=true plus effective_sample in the response. Client will show the badge and map UI slider->sample_rate param. Keep slider min 1%. rui: UX for the badge: small chip next to sampling control: "Auto 7%" with tooltip explaining "Auto: increased to improve signal for noisy workloads. Click to lock". If locked, chip becomes a lock icon. ava: Mobile gesture: prefer two-finger pan for scrubbing timeline to avoid accidental scroll. Single finger tap opens bucket details. Two-finger scrubbing will require a short coach mark on first use. lisa: Make sure two-finger gestures are discoverable and have an accessible fallback. Also ensure hit targets >=44px. theo: Visual affordance for pinned ranges: instead of dashed outline use a faint ribbon on the left edge of the card + pin icon. Ribbon ID color uses token-accent-3; add aria-label "Pinned time range" for SR. morgan: Ops: pin must be per-user and non-invasive. If someone pins a range, it doesn't alter other users' views. Also we should track pin state in local route params and optionally persist to /prefs if user chooses "save view". celeste: On copy: switch "sample rate" -> "Data sample". Short tooltip -> "p95: 214 ms". SR readout -> long form "95th percentile latency: 214 milliseconds" when verbose mode on. For minimap scrubber label use concise numbers e.g., "12:30 - 12:35, p95 214 ms". jamal: Chart render: keep Canvas for main paint. For the minimap and scrubber, small SVG overlay is fine. DOM mirror only when needed. lisa: Aria snippet for gridcell I propose (use this in spec): ```
``` When focused, set tabindex=0 and announce concise summary. Debounce live announcements 250ms after last change. ava: Also proposing a non-audible SR cue option: a very short tonal chime in verbose mode when user lands on an important bucket (opt-in). There are privacy/accessibility considerations so this must be off by default and documented. Thoughts? lisa: I like the idea but it must strictly be opt-in and use system audio APIs with permission. Provide a text-only alternative. Document in a11y docs. rui: Implementation detail: when many panels on the page, avoid activating expensive mirror or SR updates unless the user is interacting with a single card. We can lazy-load a11y mirror on focus. jamal: Agree. We'll also add server-side effective_sample, user_prefs for reduced-motion and verbosity, and baseline endpoint /api/v1/baselines?mode=previous. ava: Final microcopy decisions: legend -> "Latency (ms)", percentiles inline when space permits ("p50 p95"), sampling label -> "Data sample", sampling badge -> "Auto 7%" when autotune engaged. Minimap under chart with snap-to-bucket scrubber and keyboard arrows. Two-finger pan on mobile (with coach mark). SR modes: concise vs verbose. Pin per-user + optional save. design-bot: Ava uploaded prototype -> https://redwood.app/figma/minimap-autotune-sampler. ava: Thanks team. I'll update the Figma and hand off a short implementation spec with aria snippets and the new prefs flags. Sync tomorrow 11am PT to review implementation blockers.
